name: 文件结构分析
description: 分析 file naming 模式, 分辨率 characteristics, aspect ratios, and bytes-per-pixel ratios 以检测 AI生成的 images based on file-level characteristics. AI tools produce files with distinctive structural signatures.
mechanism:
The file structure 分析 performs multi-dimensional 模式 matching:

1. **File Naming Convention Analysis**: 检查 filenames for AI-typical 模式 (UUID strings, hash-based names like `image_00001.png`, `txt2img_xxx`, `comfyui_xxx`) vs camera-typical 模式 (DSC_xxxx, IMG_xxxx, P1000xxx, DSCN_xxxx).

2. **Resolution Fingerprinting**: Matches image dimensions against known AI model output sizes (512×512, 768×768, 1024×1024, 2048×2048) and checks for multiples of 64 (VAE latent space alignment).

3. **Aspect Ratio Analysis**: 比较 aspect ratios against standard camera sensor ratios (3:2, 4:3, 16:9) vs AI-typical ratios (1:1 square outputs).

4. **Bytes-per-Pixel Ratio**: 计算 file size relative to pixel count. AI生成的 images often have different compression characteristics than camera captures.

5. **File Extension Consistency**: Validates that file extension matches actual format headers (magic bytes).
parameters:
AI分辨率: 512², 768², 1024², 2048²
VAE对齐: 64的倍数
AI模式: UUID, hash, image_N, txt2img, comfyui
相机模式: DSC, IMG, P, DSCN, GOPR, DJI
accuracy: Medium - 70-80%. Most effective combined with other 元数据 signals. High 准确度 for unmodified AI outputs with original filenames.
source: Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney输出格式分析
useCase: First-pass triage in AI 检测 workflows. Quickly 识别 obvious AI生成的 content based on file-level 元数据 before deeper pixel 分析. Useful for batch processing large image collections.
strengths:
• 极快——仅操作文件元数据
• 检测常见AI工具输出
• 分辨率指纹对AI模型高度特异
• 64倍数检查检测基于VAE的生成器
• 即使没有EXIF数据也能工作
limitations:
• 通过重命名或调整大小轻松绕过
• 许多合法图像使用1:1比率
• 消费相机分辨率与AI输出重叠
• 无法检测后处理的AI图像
• 模式随新工具出现而演变

references.title: Rombach, R. et al. (2022). High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models. CVPR 2022.
Ramesh, A. et al. (2022). Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents.
Kee, E., et al. (2011). Digital image authentication from JPEG headers. IEEE TIFS.
